page.description: The page number to return. Defaults to 1. `page * per_page` cannot exceed 10000.

per_page.description: The number of rules to return per page. Defaults to 20.

filter.description: A KQL filter to apply to the rules. Supported fields: id, kind, enabled, metadata.name, metadata.description, metadata.tags, metadata.routing_tags. Cannot be empty. Omit it to list every rule.

sort_field.description: The field to sort rules by.

search.description: A text string to search across rule fields.
